headline: Chowan overtake Young Harris as the conference's top scorers
dek: Chowan's 22 goals are the most in the conference, and eleven different players have shared them. The goals have not bought a clean record: Chowan have lost two matches and drawn two, and Young Harris, still unbeaten, remain above them in the table.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Chowan's 22 goals have come from eleven different scorers and still sit beside two defeats and two draws; goals have not been the shortage.

wire.line: King have lost every match they have played; Lees-McRae have yet to lose one.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fourteen matches dated before today carry no result at all, the earliest Converse's home match against Spartanburg Methodist and the latest Virginia State's home match against Mount Olive.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: King have lost all seven of their matches, scoring three goals and conceding eighteen; only two players have scored for them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Enzo Joly, a freshman, has seven of Emmanuel's sixteen goals, from 26 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lees-McRae have won six matches and drawn two and are yet to lose; they have conceded four goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Young Harris have won five matches and drawn two and are yet to lose; they have conceded five goals.

last_match.line: Young Harris remain unbeaten by anyone this season; Emmanuel have now lost a conference match for the first time.

next_match.line: Francis Marion have won every conference match they have played; Emmanuel's only conference defeat came at Young Harris.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
